name: @effectified/sharp
tagline: a builder that is also a Node stream

decisions.question: Which exported functions and classes does the facade offer?
decisions.why: every exported function or class that is async or yields a handle

decisions.question: Which method releases a Sharp, so acquiring one opens a scope? ("none" keeps it unscoped)
decisions.why: its type has no release method

decisions.question: Which events of Sharp does the facade offer as Streams? ("none" for none)
Which upstream failures become which tagged errors?
decisions.why: exported error classes, most specific first, then the catch-all SharpError carrying `code` (the source sets ERR_DLOPEN_DISABLED)

decisions.question: Which handles are provided as services (Context.Service with a layer)?
decisions.why: every offered export that acquires a releasable handle

decisions.question: Which revision of this upstream version is the facade?
decisions.why: engine 0.3.0: interrupting a call aborts upstream's signal, a facade handed back to upstream is unwrapped, optional methods are wrapped, and errors carry their upstream class's fields
